entities.name: Glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase
observations: Exact 339-residue sequence match to reviewed Yersinia glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] proteins, with 100% identity and full coverage.
Catalyzes reversible redox interconversion of dihydroxyacetone phosphate and sn-glycerol 3-phosphate using NAD+ or NADP+; EC 1.1.1.94.
Predicted cytosolic enzyme involved in glycerol-3-phosphate and glycerophospholipid metabolism.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 36.19 kDa and theoretical pI is 7.71.
Pfam domains include NAD_Gly3P_dh_N (PF01210) at residues 8-163 and NAD_Gly3P_dh_C (PF07479) at residues 184-323, supporting the glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase family assignment.
Reference annotation identifies an active-site proton acceptor at position 195 and NAD-associated binding residues/features.

entities.name: DHAP reduction to G3P
observations: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + NAD(+) is the oxidative direction; the reverse direction reduces dihydroxyacetone phosphate to sn-glycerol 3-phosphate using NADH.
Rhea references include RHEA:11092 and RHEA:11096 for NAD+- and NADP+-linked directions.

entities.name: Glycerophospholipid metabolism
observations: Glycerol-3-phosphate produced by this enzyme is a key precursor for bacterial membrane phospholipid synthesis.
The enzyme is also annotated to carbohydrate metabolism and glycerol-3-phosphate biosynthetic and catabolic processes.

entities.name: Bacterial cytosol
observations: Reviewed reference proteins are annotated to the cytoplasm/cytosol; the sequence lacks an obvious signal peptide or transmembrane segment, consistent with a soluble intracellular enzyme.
